name: SOC Alerts
description: Captures threat feed alerts, stores them in the KV Store, and renders them in the webapp. Certification lab, modules 5 and 6.

settings_schema.header: Stores alerts posted to the SOC alerts channel and exposes them over HTTP.

settings.help_text: Only posts in this channel are captured. Track setup fills this in, so you should not need to touch it. Note this is the channel ID, not its name.
